title: Changed your Rhino model? Press Update

hook.text: Changed your Rhino model? Press Update

post.youtube_title: Changed your Rhino model? Press Update
post.caption:
Hide or change part of your piece in Rhino, then press Update on the HeyGema toolbar. The piece comes back in HeyGema with the same metal, stones and angle, ready to render.

Install it in Rhino: type PackageManager, search heygema and click Install.
How it works: https://www.heygema.com/en/rhino?utm_source=youtube&utm_medium=shorts&utm_campaign=yt-rhino-update
